purpose: The site-wide pattern for an off-domain link: a real <a> with its label, classes and surrounding markup intact but NO href attribute.

states.note: No interactive state exists. A generator must not add one.

buildConstraint: 'NO EXTERNAL REQUESTS' is a deliberate build constraint of this clone, not a bug. Every off-domain link renders without an href; every asset is local under /assets/. The original's Calendly iframe embeds are replaced by a static placeholder and nothing loads assets.calendly.com.
honestNote: `grep -rn 'https\?://' src/` is NOT empty, contrary to a build brief's claim: src/data/alternatives.js retains real competitor URLs as DATA in its `sources[]` rows (e.g. https://bonusly.com/pricing), and several component comments quote a real URL. The constraint holds at the RENDER layer only — SourcesList renders every source as an <a> with no href, so no off-domain request is ever issued.
